title: Detection, Classification, and Mitigation of Gender Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates gender bias through a three-task framework: (1) binary classification to detect if a sentence contains gender bias (measured by F1-score), (2) multi-label classification to categorize the bias into specific types such as Activity and Career Choices, Stereotyped Descriptions, and Attitudes/Norms/Beliefs (measured by Macro-F1 score), and (3) evaluating the quality of debiased sentence rewrites using the BLEU metric.
